The IRTE for an assigned device can trigger a POSTED_INTR_VECTOR even
if APICv is disabled on the vCPU that receives it.  In that case
interrupt will just cause a vmexit and leave the ON bit set together
with the PIR bit corresponding to the interrupt.

column2: the interrupt would not be delivered until APICv is re-enabled.
fixing this is just a matter of always doing the PIR->IRR
even if the vCPU has temporarily disabled APICv.
